releaseNotes: v1.2.8: Redesigned the Delivery Note Signatory section into a spacious 3-zone Dispatch & Receiving Verification Grid (with generous full-width writing lines for Names, Signatures, Times, and a dedicated Client Receiving Stamp box, automatically upgrading existing saved Delivery Notes), fixed underscore fill-in parsing, and enhanced Official Stamp & Signature cropping and contrast across all PDFs and previews.
